description:
Spacious three bedroom fully furnished homes with beautiful gardens in West Dublin. In an established community just a short walk from the heart of Lucan, enjoy being surrounded by plentiful green space, great shopping and a selection of much loved restaurants.

With thoughtfully designed open-plan layouts and good sized gardens, these charming homes provide spaces for relaxing and entertaining. Enjoy excellent features throughout, finest quality finishes and a sustainable design that delivers outstanding energy performance.

Sitting in the River Liffey valley, this sought after village has a distinctly rural feel, despite its proximity to Dublin city centre. Step outside into the great outdoors - beautiful local parks, rolling woodlands and plenty of activities on the water. Great local restaurants, plus shopping opportunities and road links for quick access to Dublin and Ireland's wider road network.

At Occu, we believe that renting should be better. That's why we're working hard to bring you the best: smarter, benefit focused and centred around the needs of our residents. No uncertainty, no hidden costs, stunning homes (and we'll let your pets move in too!).

Standard features of Occu Gandon Park Houses include: large kitchens with dining area, spacious living rooms, master ensuite, patio and garden, plenty of storage areas, excellent energy efficiency and family bathroom.

Gandon Park residents benefit from: 

Pet friendly
Two parking spaces per home
Landscaped garden with patio
Speedy maintenance with online management app
Onsite playground
A3 BER Energy rating
Provision for electric car charging points
Smoke and carbon monoxide alarms
Security alarms fitted
Wired for high-speed broadband and TV
Solar photovoltaic panels
USB charging points

** Please note, photos may not be specific to this house but all houses are finished to similar standard **
